definitions.explanation: Describes something grand, impressive in appearance or quality.
Worthy of respect or praise; describes people or their achievements.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立派|りっぱ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{立派|りっぱ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立派|りっぱ}な⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My son became a fine doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立派|りっぱ}な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Learning from failure is an admirable thing.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{立派|りっぱ}な⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: They live in a magnificent house.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
{立派|りっぱ}な⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
{立派|りっぱ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They responded with a respectable attitude.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}なお⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}に→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see a magnificent temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立派|りっぱ}な⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}ちました→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A splendid building was built in front of the station.

notes:
{立派|りっぱ} is a na-adjective describing something worthy of respect or admiration.

FORMS:
- {立派|りっぱ}な + noun: a fine/splendid ~
- {立派|りっぱ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: admirably, splendidly
- {立派|りっぱ}だ/です: is splendid

FUNCTIONS:
1. Physical impressiveness: {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ (magnificent building), {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧ (splendid garden)
2. Moral/character praise: {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (respectable person), {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (admirable attitude)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {立派|りっぱ}: worthy of respect. For things it means imposing scale and solid quality; for people it means moral soundness and having become what one should be. The praise is about standing, not about beauty or enjoyment.
- ⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧: wonderful. Reports the speaker's own delight and applies to anything — weather, music, news — including things that have no dignity to speak of.
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧: splendid, masterly. Praises skill and execution, how well something was carried off, so it fits performances and craftsmanship where {立派|りっぱ} would sound off.

WATCH OUT:
- The honorific form ご{立派|りっぱ} is frequently sarcastic in speech: ご{立派|りっぱ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ said flatly reads as "aren't you impressive" rather than genuine praise. Plain {立派|りっぱ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ is the safe way to compliment.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {立派|りっぱ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: to grow up well
- {立派|りっぱ}な⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a fine adult
- {立派|りっぱ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to succeed admirably

Often used when praising someone's growth or encouraging children about their future.
